locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure, zero extension, and the source-limit normalization
locked_conventions.inner_product: antilinear in the first argument; all locked ground and coefficient fixtures are real
locked_conventions.half_paired_trace: Z_0=sum_(k=1)^N rho_k^(-2); the trace over both roots +/-rho_k is 2*Z_0 and is not used in the locked formulas
locked_conventions.prime_block_sign: minus, retained inside the complete source matrix before every ground, pencil, inverse, determinant, cofactor, or leverage operation
locked_conventions.complete_matrix: Q=Q_pole-Q_arch-Q_prime in the explicit source-block notation, with the corrected archimedean formula pinned by P0_SOURCE_LOCK.json
locked_conventions.source_normalization: 4*hat(k_lambda^+) tends to Xi; unit-normalizing h_lambda is rejected
locked_conventions.boundary_normalization: division by c=<eta,x> is permitted only after c!=0; p_1/p_0 and the zero-height trace are ground-line scale invariant
locked_conventions.exterior_tail: the finite curvature identity retains +(L/(2*pi))^2*sum_(n>N)n^(-2) before solving for the quotient trace
locked_conventions.finite_status: all zero-height, cofactor, coefficient, curvature, and shifted-reserve identities are finite reductions, not an arithmetic unbounded-schedule theorem or determinant-limit claim

locked_domains.zero_height: the complete finite source matrix has a simple inversion-even full ground x, c=<eta,x>!=0, xi_0=x_0/c>0, and T_-=Q_- -epsilon*I>0; equivalently the quotient has no zero pair and s_k^2>0
locked_domains.coefficient_cone: alternatively epsilon is the simple lowest even-compression eigenvalue, c and x_0 are nonzero, and p_j>0 for every 0<=j<=N, which supplies the finite odd sign and positive roots
locked_domains.curvature: M_N(sigma)=hat(x)(i*sigma)/c is differentiated in the real variable sigma at zero; M_N(0)=sqrt(L)*xi_0 is nonzero
locked_domains.pencil_inverse: mathfrak K=C^*T_+C and T_- are positive definite before mathfrak K^(-1), the logarithmic derivative at s=0, and the cofactor ratio are used
locked_domains.odd_resolvent: T_->0 and 1+<g_0,T_-^(-1)beta>=xi_0>0 are required before the relative odd-resolvent quotient is formed
locked_domains.local_boundedness: Z_0 is uniformly bounded and N/L^2 is bounded away from zero; N/L^2->infinity is required to make the exterior tail vanish
locked_domains.projective_curvature: mu=epsilon<=U, B=A-U*I>0, <kappa,x>!=0, K_0=hat(kappa)(0)!=0, a uniform bound on |K_2/K_0| is required for the asymptotic conclusion, and the finite odd-positive hypotheses are separate inputs
locked_domains.mixed_cofactor: T_+=Q_+-epsilon*I is positive semidefinite with one-dimensional kernel and <eta,x>!=0; the bordered determinant is ordered as [[T_+,eta],[g_r^*,0]]
locked_domains.trace_radius: p_j>0 for every j and the source positive symmetrizer are required before lambda_max(X)<=Tr(X)=p_(N-1); the inequality is not asserted without a real positive spectrum
locked_domains.shifted_trace_reserve: the coefficient cone, epsilon<=U<lambda_min(A), g_+=lambda_min(A)-U>0, and the Schur-surplus hypotheses from checkpoint 0.47 are separate inputs
locked_domains.hellmann_feynman: the finite even ground eigenvalue is simple and the positive-transform denominators are nonzero; tau and sigma are distinct positive heights for the noncollinearity obstruction

locked_formulas.zero_height_trace: Z_0=sum_(k=1)^N rho_k^(-2)=(L/(2*pi))^2*p_1/p_0, rho_k=2*pi*s_k/L; this is the half-paired trace
locked_formulas.curvature_with_exterior: M_N''(0)/(2*M_N(0))=(L/(2*pi))^2*(p_1/p_0+sum_(n>N)n^(-2)); equivalently Z_0 is this quadratic logarithmic coefficient minus the positive exterior tail
locked_formulas.principal_even_trace: if H is the positive nonzero-mode principal block of T_+ and D_o=diag(1,...,N), then p_1/p_0=Tr(D_o^(-1)*H^(-1)*D_o^(-1)*T_-)
locked_formulas.second_moment: if the actual boundary-normalized ground polynomial is pointwise nonnegative, Z_0=(1/2)*E_mu[y^2]-(L/(2*pi))^2*sum_(n>N)n^(-2), y=L*(theta-pi)/(2*pi)
locked_formulas.fixed_height_domination: S^q_m(sigma)<=Z_0^m for every integer m>=1 and sigma>=0
locked_formulas.local_boundedness_schedule_obstruction: for N=1, xi_0=L^2 and xi_1=(1-L^2)/2 give Z_0=1/(4*pi^2), rho_1=2*pi, the pointwise-positive ground F_1(theta)=L^2+(1-L^2)*cos(theta)>=1 for L>=1, and the normalized product F(iR)>=(1+R^2*L^2/(16*pi^2))->infinity for every fixed R>0
locked_formulas.mixed_cofactor_coefficients: g_r=e_r(E_N)e_0^+ + sqrt(2)*sum_n e_r(E_N without n^2)e_n^+ and p_(N-r)=<g_r,adj(T_+)eta>/<eta,adj(T_+)eta>
locked_formulas.bordered_cone: p_(N-r)>0 iff det([[T_+,eta],[g_r^*,0]])<0 because the denominator is positive and the bordered determinant is -<g_r,adj(T_+)eta>
locked_formulas.trace_radius: inside the coefficient cone, lambda_max(X)<=Tr(X)=p_(N-1)=sum_(n=1)^N n^2-2*sum_(n=1)^N n^2*xi_n
locked_formulas.origin_leverage: E_U*L_0<=eta^2*|K_0|^2 and E_U*L_(J,0)<=C_2^2*|K_0|^4 with eta<1 bound the deviation from K_2/K_0; a uniform bound on |K_2/K_0| and the finite odd-positive hypotheses then bound the origin quadratic logarithmic coefficient and Z_0
locked_formulas.fourier_origin_functionals: ell_0(phi_0)=sqrt(L), ell_0(phi_n)=0 for n!=0, ell_2(phi_0)=L^(5/2)/24, and ell_2(phi_n)=L^(5/2)/(4*pi^2*n^2) for n!=0
locked_formulas.hellmann_feynman_ratio: for Q_+(r;u)=Q_++r|ell_u><ell_u|, (M_N(tau)/M_N(sigma))^2=epsilon_tau'(0)/epsilon_sigma'(0); noncollinear ell_tau and ell_sigma forbid a positive rank-one Loewner domination
locked_formulas.coefficient_probability: alpha=sigma*L/(2*pi), gamma=tau*L/(2*pi), T_N=product_(n>N)(n^2+alpha^2)/(n^2+gamma^2), P(J=j)=d_j*alpha^(2*j)/det(G+alpha^2*I), E[J]=d_eff(alpha), R^q(tau,sigma)=E[(tau/sigma)^(2*J)], and M_N(tau)/M_N(sigma)=T_N^(-1)*E[(tau/sigma)^(2*J)]
locked_formulas.n1_obstruction: for N=1, P_x(s)=s+xi_0, the complete coefficient cone is xi_0>0, and p_1/p_0=1/xi_0 is unbounded as xi_0 tends to zero from above
locked_formulas.positive_ground_countermodel: for s_1^2=3/4 and s_n^2=n^2 for 2<=n<=N, Z_0=(L/(2*pi))^2*(4/3+sum_(n=2)^N n^(-2)), despite exact Cauchy displacement, pointwise-positive ground, positive coefficients, and uniformly conditioned positive odd block
